subject: Issues running ldsc() function after updating.

messages.author: a496ef30cb6c9532
messages.subject: Issues running ldsc() function after updating.
parts:
Hello,

I attempted to update GSEM and then rerun some models.  When I run this script (which worked previously):

traits <- c("OUD2020.sumstats.gz", "PAU2020.sumstats.gz", "PTU.sumstats.gz", "../CUD.sumstats.gz")
sample.prev <- c(NA,NA,NA,NA)
population.prev <- c(NA, NA, NA, NA)
ld <- "../eur_w_ld_chr/"
wld <- "../eur_w_ld_chr/"
trait.names<-c("OUD", "PAU", "PTU", "CUD")
LDSCoutputAFactor <- ldsc(traits=traits, sample.prev=sample.prev, population.prev=population.prev, ld=ld, wld=wld, trait.names=trait.names)

I get the warning:
Warning in file(paste0(log2, "_ldsc.log"), open = "wt") :
  cannot open file 'OUD2020.sumstats.gz_PAU2020.sumstats.gz_PTU.sumstats.gz_../CUD.sumstats.gz_ldsc.log': No such file or directory
Error in file(paste0(log2, "_ldsc.log"), open = "wt") : 
  cannot open the connection

Is there a larger version issue here? Or did I miss something obvious?

Alex

I'll keep posting on my own thread in case it helps someone else :)

This problem happens when you try to naivate up or down directories in the traits vector. 

So

Doesn't work and produces an error with the recent download, but if I move CUD to the same folder

traits <- c("OUD2020.sumstats.gz", "PAU2020.sumstats.gz", "PTU.sumstats.gz", "CUD.sumstats.gz")

Does work. 

Alex

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: Issues running ldsc() function after updating.
parts:
Hi Alex, 

Thanks for bringing this up! As you highlighted,  an error was specifically being thrown when trying to write the .log file when navigating up in a working directory using "../". I put in a small patch to the ldsc function so you should be able to now run ldsc without it throwing an error using your original code. 

Best, 
  Andrew
